entries.claim: This proper page prints the 19-word body (w001–w019) and the abbreviated Per Dóminum cue. The full w020–w041 conclusion and Amen are not printed in full on this proper page; the same-edition RG 115 a dependency supplies them. Adjacent Queenship material, Common references and headings are excluded. This is a narrow textual source claim, not commemoration, calendar or actor approval.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; ordinary conclusion addressed to the Father, with Amen

entries.claim: RG115a supplies the ordinary 21-word conclusion and Amen, w020–w041, after the proper body’s abbreviated cue. Body and formula are separate loci, not one continuous proper-page printing or two independent witnesses. The rubric enumeration’s terminal Amen semicolon is retained in the literal witness and set as a response period in the selected text. This rule alone does not determine the response actor.
